title: Classify the post-grant reviewer reset no-outbox branch without replay, mutation or identity exposure

the classifier never repeats the password-reset request and performs no HTTP POST, mail send, password change, MFA or session change, database write, privilege change, deployment or container lifecycle operation

historical evidence is fixed to command comment 5308992681, result comment 5308999892, source revision 440e40753e2cac13c93f8e007d9fe17c2b66caba and UTC window 2026-08-16T18:24:53Z through 2026-08-16T18:28:00Z
